lines.before: 8. **Skills by case.** The kit's `.claude/kit/skill-cases.json` maps each kind of task to the skills it loads. Each project turns its cases on in `.claude/skill-cases.local.json`; the session-start hook lists those skills. At most two skills per unit of work; design-time, motion and review-time sets stay apart. Why: the right skill unused is no skill, and too many dilute each other. *Check: tests confirm every named skill exists.*
lines.after: 8. **Skills by case.** The kit's `.claude/kit/skill-cases.json` maps each kind of task to the skills it loads. Each project turns its cases on in `.claude/skill-cases.local.json`; the session-start hook lists those skills. At most two skills per unit of work; design-time, motion and review-time sets stay apart. A rarely used plugin is a **standby plugin**: off in the Claude config folder's settings, named on its case (`plugin`), and switched on per project in `.claude/settings.local.json`; session start says how when a turned-on case needs one that is off. Why: the right skill unused is no skill, and too many dilute each other. *Check: tests confirm every named skill exists.*
lines.why: the owner, 2026-10-31: rarely used plugins stay off globally and switch on per project as standby plugins
